name: Succimer

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Hypersensitivity and dermatologic reactions: Interrupt treatment if rash or mucocutaneous vesicular eruptions occur. summary: Warnings for Succimer include watching for allergic skin issues, such as rashes or fluid-filled blisters on the skin and moist inner linings of the body, which require stopping treatment [3]. Patients must also be checked for neutropenia, which is a low count of a specific type of infection-fighting white blood cell, as well as signs of infection and liver toxicity [3]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, evaluated the drug and gave it low risk scores for both liver and heart problems [M].
